articles.title: Uppåt på Wall Street – Anthropic rusade
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Uppåt på Wall Street – Anthropic rusade
articles.body_text: Handlarna på Wall Street ser kurserna rusa. Arkivbild. New York-börserna avslutade fredagshandeln på plus efter en turbulent vecka. Anthropic rusade och handlas återigen över förra veckans teckningskurs. Tekniktunga Nasdaqs kompositindex avslutade på plus 2,3 procent, medan breda S&P 500 och Dow Jones industriindex stängde upp 1,6 respektive 1,2 procent. AI-bolaget Anthropic, som i förra veckan börsintroducerades för 83 dollar per aktie, rusade 10,8 procent. Aktien kostar nu 91,76 dollar. Nvidia, med Jensen Huang som återinsattes som vd i måndags, vände en betydande nedgång i den tidiga fredagshandeln till plus 0,9 procent. It-jättarna Meta och Amazon klättrade 3,1 respektive 4,0 procent. USA-börserna hade halvdag på fredagen, dagen efter högtiden thanksgiving.

articles.title: Därför har Stockholmsbörsen stått emot AI-frossan
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Därför har Stockholmsbörsen stått emot AI-frossan
articles.body_text: Anthropic börsintroducerades nyligen på Nasdaq i New York. Arkivbild. Därför har Stockholmsbörsen stått emot AI-frossan AI-oron har fått världens börser att darra kraftigt den senaste tiden. Samma påverkan har däremot inte synts på Stockholmsbörsen som är bland de bättre i år. Sverige har ju stått emot, säger Maria Landeborn på Danske Bank. Gigantiska AI-bolag med stora investeringar har fått marknaderna att tveka lite – hur lönsamt blir det här egentligen? Dessutom har turbulensen inom Nvidia, med vd Jensen Huangs avgång och comeback, samt AI-jätten Anthropics börsintroduktion lett till ytterligare svängningar på världens börser. Fokus har gått från att bara se positivt på att man investerar till att i stället ha börjat fundera på vad det här kommer att ge för avkastning på sikt. Epicentrum i vad som har varit stökigt på marknaden är ju techaktier och AI-aktier, säger Landeborn, sparekonom på Danske Bank. Kriget i Mellanöstern, höga energipriser och centralbanker som höjer räntorna spelar också roll. Även mellanårsvalet i USA har påverkat. Men i denna börsstorm har Stockholmsbörsen klarat sig rätt bra, menar Landeborn. Det beror ju på att det framför allt har varit stora kursrörelser hos techbolagen. Vi har inte så mycket techbolag på Stockholmsbörsen. På Stockholmsbörsen är det i stället mer banker och industribolag. De har inte omvärderats och ifrågasatts på samma sätt som techbolagen. Sedan har vi haft en bra rapportsäsong här och konjunkturen har överraskat positivt, vilket är bra för svenska och även europeiska bolag, tillägger hon.

articles.title: Konsumentverket varnar för dropshipping på Black Friday
articles.summary: Konsumentverket varnar för dropshipping på Black Friday
articles.body_text: Nya varningen för Black friday: ”Man vet inte vad man får” Konsumentverket: Här är tre saker du ska kontrollera • ”Vila på hanen” Black Week lockar med låga priser – men också med risker. Konsumentverket manar nätshoppare att vara extra försiktiga, särskilt vid köp från så kallade dropshippingföretag. – Man vet inte vad man får eller ens om man får någonting, säger Fredrik Selrot, vägledare på Konsumentverket. En ”sund misstänksamhet” när man handlar. Det förordar Konsumentverket lagom till Black Friday idag. Konsumentverket uppmanar konsumenter att vara försiktiga vid köp på nätet, och varnar för den senaste trenden med så kallade ”dropshippingföretag”. – Dropshippingföretag är egentligen inga företag. De har ingen logistikhantering, ingen lagerhantering, ingen personal, ingenting. Det är bara en webbsida på nätet, säger Fredrik Selrot, vägledare på Konsumentverket. Selrot beskriver hur ett köp via en sådan webbsida kan gå till. – När du går in och köper den här kjolen du har hittat vidarebefordras beställningen till en fabrik i Kina. Därifrån skickas ett polyestertyg hem till dig, och förhoppningen är att du ska betala. Du vet inte vad du får – eller ens om du får någonting alls. Selrot uppmanar den som vill handla att granska kontaktuppgifter och företagets hantering av reklamationer och ångerrätt. – Du vill kolla på tre saker. Du vill kolla på kontaktuppgifter till företaget. Kan jag hitta adress? Kan jag hitta telefonnummer? Finns det till och med organisationsnummer? Sedan vill jag också kolla och se på hur företagets reklamations- och ångerrättshantering fungerar. Man vet inte vad man får eller om man får någonting, säger Fredrik Selrot. Han råder också konsumenter att inte fatta köpbeslut för snabbt. – Vila på hanen. Vänta lite. Ta ett par minuter till och kolla innan du klipper till och köper det som du är sugen på att köpa. Vänta ett ögonblick.

articles.title: Lågt förtroende för Black friday – men vi vill ändå handla
articles.summary: Bara en av tio litar på rabatten • Så ser lagen ut
articles.body_text: Lågt förtroende för Black friday – men vi vill ändå handla Bara en av tio litar på rabatten • Så ser lagen ut I måndags 08:14 ・ Uppdaterad: I måndags 08:59 Förtroendet för Black week-rean är fortsatt lågt bland svenska konsumenter. Trots det planerar många att handla. – Det är bara en av tio som litar på att rabatterna är verkliga, säger Isabella Ahmadi, konsumentexpert på Prisjakt. En undersökning gjord på uppdrag av Prisjakt visar att en majoritet av svenskarna misstror de erbjudanden som marknadsförs under Black week och Black friday. Många tror att priserna höjs inför rean eller att jämförpriserna är missvisande, vilket gör att rabatterna framstår som större än de egentligen är. – Majoriteten tror inte på erbjudandena. Det är en stor misstro till att rabatterna är så bra som de ser ut, säger Isabella Ahmadi, konsumentexpert på Prisjakt. Hon menar att det finns flera säljknep inom handeln för att få konsumenter att handla mer än planerat. Det kan handla om gratis frakt över en viss summa, nedräkningar eller märkningar som ”populär” och ”säljer snabbt”. – Men det allra vanligaste är att vi faller för rabatten. Vi ser procentsatsen och tänker att så här mycket sparar jag. Vi glömmer lite bort vad varan faktiskt kostar och vad den kan ha kostat tidigare också för den delen, säger Isabella Ahmadi. D et finns lagstiftning som kräver att butiker redovisar det lägsta priset de senaste 30 dagarna, men förtroendet för lagen är lågt. 55 procent av de tillfrågade tror inte att reglerna fungerar som de ska. Henrik Ekelund, policyansvarig på Svensk Handel, menar att deras medlemmar följer lagen och att branschen arbetar aktivt för att stärka förtroendet. – Våra medlemsföretag jobbar varje dag för att ge bra erbjudanden och service till konsumenterna. Men det är klart att aktörer som tar genvägar kan sabotera förtroendet, säger han. Han anser att de skärpta reglerna har gjort rean tryggare och att den klassiska ”fulrean” blivit ovanligare. Han uppmanar konsumenter att själva följa prisutvecklingen på varor de är intresserade av och att planera sina inköp.

articles.title: Fällorna i Black Week-rean: ”Är för att lura hjärnan”
articles.summary: Expertens bästa tips • Sakerna du ska undvika
articles.body_text: Fällorna i Black Week-rean: ”Är för att lura hjärnan” Expertens bästa tips • Sakerna du ska undvika I söndags 10:48 ・ Uppdaterad: I söndags 10:48 Rea-veckan Black Week startar i morgon, och många hoppas kanske plocka in julklappar på extrapris. Men det också fallgropar, där handlarna inte alltid använder schyssta tricks. – De som säljer vet att det här funkar på oss, säger privatekonomen Américo Fernández. Sverige har tagit till sig den amerikanska realisationsveckan Black Week, som omsätter allt mer pengar för varje år som går. I morgon startar årets upplaga, som kulminera på fredag, Black Friday. Enligt en opinionsundersökning som SEB gjort tänker svenskarna spendera mer än någonsin. – I år är snittbeloppet ungefär 1 700 kronor som genomsnittssvensken planerar att spendera på Black Week. Det är ändå 40 procent mer än vad man planerade förra året, säger SEB:s privatekonom Américo Fernández. Framför allt är det kläder, hemelektronik och skönhets- och hälsoprodukter som lockar på rean. Men även om det finns låga priser, så finns det en del fusk och fiffel också. Ett återkommande klagomål är att handlare höjer priset veckorna innan, för att sedan sänka det till Black Week. Vilket innebär att reapriset egentligen mest liknar ordinarie pris. Och enligt SEB:s sparekonom är det lätt att dras med i hysterin och marknadsföringen runt Black Week. – De som säljer vet att det funkar på oss. Det är så vi är uppbyggda. Vi är duktiga på kortsiktiga, spontana saker. Inte lika bra på det rationella, långsiktiga sparbeteendet. De lockar! Allt syftar till att vi ska konsumera, säger Américo Fernández. Under förra årets Black Week gjorde Konsumentverket stickprovskontroller hos 34 handlare. Hos 21 av företagen, det vill säga 60 procent, fanns det brister i hur väl man följde lagstiftningen runt realisationer. I elva av fallen startade Konsumentverket tillsynsärenden, och vädjade samtidigt till handlarna att skärpa sig. – Det här är ett så pass omfattande problem på marknaden. Vi behöver hjälp att få ut det brett, det måste till en självsanering, sa Niclas Ernebratt på Konsumentverket tidigare till TT.

articles.title: Publicistiska grunden för journalistik på TV4
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.summary: I oktober 2025 tog engelsmannen Graham Potter över som förbundskapten för det svenska herrlandslaget i fotboll - efter att hans föregångare Jon Dahl Tomasson misslyckats med att ta Sverige direkt till fotbolls-VM. 50-årige Potter har ett förflutet som tränare för Premier League-klubbarna Brighton och Chelsea. Men för den svenska publiken är han kanske främst förknippad med sitt tränarjobb i Östersunds FK, som han tog från division 2 ända upp till allsvenskan. Så hur ska då Graham Potter vända den negativa trend som herrlandslaget befinner sig i? Har han vad som krävs för att Sverige ska ta sig till VM i sommar? Det och mycket annat frågade SVT Sports programledare André Pops honom.

articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes
articles.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez wants to defy the polls, and his main rivals accuse him of not telling the truth and of "betrayal".
articles.body_text: Spain's main party leaders have held their final rallies ahead of Sunday's election, with Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez saying he is confident of defying the polls. "I cannot imagine us losing," he said, posing for selfies with supporters in red T-shirts and accusing conservative rival Alberto Núñez Feijóo of planning a coalition with the far right. Feijóo's People's Party (PP) is narrowly ahead in the polls, and in the final hours of the campaign he travelled first to Barcelona and then Seville, promising voters a new political era of "truth, decency and good governance". He accused Sánchez of evading questions on key issues like corruption, rail disasters, immigration and the national debt. The Socialist leader heads one of Europe's few left-wing governments, and with the French presidential elections five months away, there is a real chance that two of the continent's biggest economies could move to the right in quick succession. Almost 39 million people have a vote in Spain and while commentators expect a high turnout, most polls have suggested a close finish. Under Spanish electoral law, no polls have been published since Monday. "This time, yes, we're going to do it," Feijóo told PP supporters, in a nod to his failure to form a government three years ago despite winning most seats. If he gets to form a government this time, it will be with the support of anti-immigration party Vox, led by Santiago Abascal, whose final rally took place in a bull-ring in Valencia on Spain's east coast. Pedro Sánchez's government "has betrayed us, he has robbed us and he has lied to us", Abascal told an audience earlier in Tarancón, to the south-east of Madrid. Vox is hoping to almost double its seats from the 33 it won three years ago. It backs policies such as "national priority" - putting Spanish citizens first for welfare - and "remigration" for foreigners not considered to be contributing to the economy. The final day of campaigning was very much in the shadow of a four-way TV debate the night before that exposed Spain's sharply polarised politics. All four leaders had solutions for the housing crisis. Feijóo said the PP would build a million homes over four years, while Sánchez said housing should be a right not an object of speculation and profit.

articles.title: Paul Mackenzie: Kenyan doomsday cult leader convicted over further 123 deaths
articles.summary: Paul Mackenzie is found guilty of killing his followers, weeks after being jailed for the mass murder of children.
articles.body_text: A court in Kenya has convicted the leader of a doomsday Christian cult of the manslaughter of 123 of his followers. Paul Mackenzie was found guilty in Mombasa of ordering his followers, all adults, to fast to death in Shakahola forest near the coast between January 2021 and September 2023. Earlier this month Mackenzie was jailed for 200 years for murdering 191 people, all but one of them children, in the same mass killing. Mackenzie had pleaded not guilty to manslaughter and one of his lawyers said he would appeal against the conviction after sentencing, Reuters news agency reports. Warning: This article contains details which some people might find distressing. The court also convicted 29 others including Mackenzie's wife, Rhoda Mumbua Maweu, of their part in the manslaughter. Sixty defendants were acquitted. The Director of Public Prosecutions indicated that an appeal would be launched against their acquittal. The self-styled pastor was arrested in 2023 after the discovery of more than 400 bodies in shallow graves in the Shakahola forest, near the Indian Ocean coast. The court found Mackenzie had "systematically persuaded his followers to fast until they died", Kenya's Office of The Director of Public Prosecutions said in a statement on Friday's verdict, which it described as "the final conviction" in the cases against him. "Children were to go first, then women and then men, with Mackenzie himself meant to die last," the office said. The prosecution argued that Mackenzie and his accomplices had acted together as part of a suicide pact to fast to death in order to "meet Jesus". Witnesses testified that he had preached that education, medicine and ornaments were sinful.

articles.title: Brazil pushes back on Emmanuel Macron calling its meat 'doped'
articles.summary: France's president made the comment while speaking to French farming representatives, months after the EU banned Brazil beef and poultry products.
articles.body_text: Brazil says it "regrets" a statement by French President Emmanuel Macron who called Brazilian meat "doped". France's leader made the comment while meeting representatives of farming unions on Wednesday, during which he celebrated EU restrictions on imports of Brazilian meat and poultry which took effect in September. In its statement, the Brazilian government said Macron's statements "spread misinformation and contradict the widely available technical and scientific evidence on animal protein production in Brazil". Macron's comments come as part of a trade row between the EU and Mercosur - the South American trade bloc. The EU banned Brazilian meat, poultry and other animal products owing to the use of antimicrobials in farming. In its defence, Brazil said it had supplied animal protein to the EU for decades and that it exported meat to 177 markets. It added the country had a rigorous sanitary control system, corroborated by a recent European audit, and observed stringent environmental requirements. Macron, in his opening remarks in the meeting with the agricultural sector representatives at Élysée Palace, said he was "proud of the fight we led" against Mercosur. "And the 'doped' meat, if I may put it that way, or rather meat from Mercosur countries, especially Brazil, that was arriving in our ports and therefore entering our markets without complying with our rules, was ultimately banned," he said. Brazil said it was concerned about the "clearly political nature" of recent EU restrictions, and urged France to reconsider its position "in light of scientific evidence". Affirming its partnership with France was important, the country emphasised that "in the face of protectionist pressures, the best interests of the bilateral relationship must prevail, always guided by mutual respect and reciprocity". Brazil is a massive exporter of meat, especially beef - some $1.84bn (£1.4bn) of which went to EU markets alone in 2025, according to Brazil's agricultural ministry.

articles.title: Ukraine is bowed but still unbroken as freezing weather sets in
articles.summary: Ukraine settles in for another devastating winter as the questions persists: how will it all end?
articles.body_text: Something weird happens when you reach Kyiv after the eight-hour drive from the Polish border: the clock on your mobile phone goes to midnight. It's not really for phones - it seems to be part of a wider strategy to disorient the missiles and drones the Russians are sending over. Aside from little things like that, though, Kyiv seems fairly normal at first sight. You become well aware there's a war on when sirens begin to wail and people check their phones for the notifications which tell them there's a red alert and missiles are on their way. You can even buy gadgets that show you which direction the drones are coming from, and what type they are. The drones and ballistic missiles have been hitting in sizeable numbers over the last couple of weeks. On the morning of Monday 16 November, the battle of the bridges began. Ukraine hit the Kerch bridge which links Russia to illegally occupied Crimea. Then it launched a bigger wave of missiles and drones, damaging the central road-bridge arch. A few hours later, presumably in revenge, Russia fired seven ballistic missiles at Kyiv, disabling two of the nine bridges that cross the River Dnipro. The war has dragged on for more than four and a half years, killing what some estimate could be 100,000 Ukrainian troops and 18,000 Ukrainian civilians, according to the United Nations, and probably more. Its infrastructure, too, has been battered, as well as its morale. While temperatures drop to freezing at night, and with Ukrainians regularly suffering from no light, heat or water thanks to Russian strikes, can the country survive another difficult winter under bombardment? And what would a peace deal, if one could be struck, look like? Kyiv is mostly dark at night, thanks to Russia's campaign of targeting Ukraine's electricity generating capability. In the blackness last week, the air raid sirens started wailing across the city, and our hotel's warning announcements came over the loudspeakers. Within a few minutes, we heard the first explosions. I jumped out of bed and stared out of the window into the darkness. After a few seconds two more missiles landed, lighting up the entire sky momentarily in a blaze of white and red. They were uncomfortably close. Many people prefer to go to the shelters when there's a red alert. Others just stay in bed and hope the law of averages will protect them. It usually does. During one of the heaviest attacks last week, the number of fatalities was in single figures. I went to the shelter in our hotel one night. The clearly audible thumps and crashes above ground, the permanent lighting, the snores and grunts of other people, and the attentions of the little biting flies that seem to thrive in the warm, crowded shelters made sleep hard. To the people who live here in Kyiv, it's frightening, certainly, if a drone or a missile hits close by, but enraging too. Over the years I've been in several cities that were being bombed by high-tech weaponry and the reaction always seems the same, whether it's Lebanon, Iraq, Serbia, or Ukraine: a combination of weariness and fury. In Kyiv the attacks come by night and day, making normal life almost impossible. An uninterrupted night's sleep is a rarity. The morning after the bridges were hit, people in the streets looked tired and worn. Yet although they long for it to stop, there's no sign they want Ukraine to surrender. On the contrary, just about everyone I spoke to felt they had to keep fighting. That's borne out by an opinion poll last month by the KIIS organisation, a Ukrainian market research company, which found that 62% of people were prepared to put up with the war for as long as it took. Of those polled, 79% believed that Ukraine would win the war in the long run, and only 7% thought Russia would win. These aren't the reactions of a country which is being beaten to its knees. I don't have any doubt that Ukraine can survive the winter. Food is plentiful, though prices are high. Water is a problem, because the regular attacks on the power grid mean that it can't be pumped with any regularity. Kyiv underwent a large transformation under the Soviets, so there are large numbers of high-rise blocks of flats everywhere. Labouring up and down the stairs when there's no power is daunting, especially when you've got to carry quantities of water home. We came across a small crowd of people in their 20s who had gathered outside a nightclub for a rave at three in the afternoon, because of the 11pm curfew. "It's a way of getting a bit of respite from everything," said one young woman. "It makes me feel I can put up with everything," said a man. Do people still support President Volodymyr Zelensky? My team and I met an elderly woman wandering around Independence Square in the centre of Kyiv holding a photo of her son, who was missing on the Eastern front. She blamed Zelensky; if he didn't insist on carrying on the war, she believed, her son would still be alive. It isn't a response most people seem to share. The same polling organisation, KIIS, found that Zelensky's trust ratings hover around 54% to 57% — way below the 90% he was registering in the early days of the war in 2022, but not too bad for a man who's been in power now for more than seven years.

articles.title: 'We couldn't give up that easily': Marching bands scramble to cover costs after Thanksgiving parade rearranged
articles.summary: Stormy weather in New York City prompted organisers to push back the Macy's parade by two days - leaving some musicians stuck.
articles.body_text: Since New York City officials postponed the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, a precaution ahead of a storm that brought heavy rain, wind and flooding, hundreds of touring performers who traveled from across the US to perform were thrust into chaos. "It was jarring," said Ryan Demkovich, director of a Texas high school marching band. After learning the news, he had to scramble to make new arrangements for over 500 people. Demkovich and his Pearland High School band made the quick decision to launch a fundraiser, reaching $350,000 (£267,000) in just a few hours. Still, some performers reportedly had to skip the parade, a televised, traditional Thanksgiving event - now rescheduled for Saturday. On Wednesday afternoon, a day before the event, organisers announced the postponement, in part due to concerns around the parade's giant balloons in strong winds. The balloons, inflated on Wednesday, were then temporarily deflated - along with the spirits of those who journeyed to the city to watch the action. The move represented the first time the event had been postponed in its 100-year history, although it was suspended altogether during World War II. Each year, a number of marching bands travel from across the country, from high schools and colleges, to perform at the event. This is considered a huge opportunity, as the parade is watched by millions in person and on TV. Demkovich described an emotional and exhausting experience, first learning that the parade would be postponed while watching a Broadway performance of Wicked with his band. "My initial thought was like, 'Oh, crap. We're not going to be able to go'," he said. "Where are we going to be able to get all the money for this?" The delay meant unexpected expenses of additional nights in a hotel - and meals - for hundreds of people in the middle of New York City during the holidays.

articles.title: Canada's top court largely upholds Quebec ban on religious symbols for public servants
articles.summary: The law faced legal challenges from a range of groups, including female Muslim, Sikh and Catholic teachers, who argued it violated their fundamental rights.
articles.body_text: Canada's top court has largely upheld a Quebec law banning public sector workers from wearing religious symbols, including the hijab and the cross. The law, known as Bill 21, faced legal challenges from a range of groups, including female Muslim, Sikh and Catholic teachers, who argued it violated their fundamental rights. Quebec passed the law in 2019 under a unique fixture of Canada's constitution called the "notwithstanding clause" - a legal loophole that allows governments to override certain rights, like freedom of religion. The Supreme Court's decision is one of the most closely watched in Canadian history, with an impact that will be felt both in Quebec and across the country. Reacting to the ruling on CBC, Prime Minister Mark Carney said his government would study its implications, adding it was important for all legislatures "to respect the rights and liberties of all Canadians, including those in the minority." The Supreme Court was asked to weigh in on a number of questions, including on the constitutionality of Bill 21, whether Quebec's use of the notwithstanding clause was appropriate, and whether there are limits to its use. On Friday, the top court confirmed the validity of Bill 21, but ruled that the law infringes on democratic rights by banning Quebec's elected officials from wearing a face covering for religious reasons. The court also ruled that a Canadian court has the power to declare whether a law is consistent with the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms even if the notwithstanding clause is invoked, but that they would not do so in this case. While the majority of the seven justices found that Quebec's law is largely valid, some dissented to parts of the decision. Justices Andromache Karakatsanis, Michelle O'Bonsawin and Nicholas Kasirer wrote that the notwithstanding clause "cannot be used to authorize laws that are incompatible with the fundamental character of Canada as a free and democratic country". Specifically, they said they believe the law infringes on the charter's guarantee to freedom of religion, freedom of expression and the right to equality. Civil liberty groups in Quebec have criticised Bill 21, saying it disproportionately affects Muslim women who wear the hijab, arguing that it has excluded them from key areas of public life in the province.

articles.title: Rare turtles found inside baggage at Amsterdam airport
articles.summary: The endangered reptiles were bound with duct tape to prevent them moving, officials say.
articles.body_text: Twenty-six "very rare" turtles have been seized from a traveller's checked baggage at Amsterdam's Schiphol airport, a Dutch government agency has said. The Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA) said a man flying from Mexico to Hong Kong via the airport was arrested on Saturday after the Vallarta mud turtles were found by customs officers. The endangered species, thought to be the smallest freshwater turtles in the world with a maximum length of about 10cm (4in), were wrapped in duct tape to prevent them from moving. The NVWA said they were "presumably stolen" from the wild in their native Mexico. It said most of the turtles were found in a box with a toy car, while the others were in a closed sock inside a suitcase. The arrested man remains in custody and an investigation is under way. Meanwhile, the turtles are receiving care at a "specialised sanctuary", the NVWA said. In 2025, the US NGO Turtle Island estimated that no more than 300 Vallarta mud turtles existed in the wild. They are listed as critically endangered on a list published by the International Union for Conservation of Nature. According to environmental news outlet Mongabay, a Vallarta mud turtle can sell for $10,000 (£7,500) or more on the black market in Asia. Other cases of live turtles being smuggled to Hong Kong have been reported this year. In October, customs authorities in Hong Kong were reported to have seized eight turtles that were thought to be endangered. The reptiles had an estimated market value of about $54,000.

articles.title: Grace Tame: Ex-media executive admits saying child sex abuse survivor 'looking to be raped again'
articles.summary: The former Murdoch media executive was overheard at an event referring to the way Grace Tame was dressed.
articles.body_text: An Australian former media executive has admitted he said a child sex abuse survivor and prominent advocate "must be looking to be raped again" because of the way she was dressed at an event. Grace Tame, 31, was groomed and abused by a teacher and has been honoured as Australian of the Year in 2021 for her advocacy work on child safety. In an op-ed for independent media outlet Crikey, Tame said she overheard Matt Handbury speaking to a friend, and was left distressed by the remark and the failure of others who heard it to intervene. Handbury, nephew of Rupert Murdoch and a former executive at his firms, has not responded to a BBC request for comment, but in an email to Tame said he regretted the "highly objectionable" comment as soon as he said it. Tame wrote in the Crikey article that she confronted Handbury - who she hadn't met before - immediately, and again later in the evening to check she had heard him correctly. She said the encounter at the University of New South Wales event last week triggered flashbacks to her abuse and left her feeling like she would vomit. "My whole body was prickling in distress," she wrote for Crikey. "The many men and women who'd seen the confrontation were incredulous, and quick to express their anger at Matt's behaviour... Ironically though, in a room full of seasoned activists, journalists, lawyers and actual whistleblowers, not one person besides me took Matt to task in the heat of the moment." The next day, in an email seen by the BBC, Handbury, 77, apologised for the "attempt at humour in less than poor taste". "I did make reference to your strikingly attractive get-up... I also said: 'She must be looking to be raped again.' He thanked her for "calling me out" and "opening my eyes more fully to this flaw in my nature which I will certainly be discussing with my very non-misogynist shrink". "But no-one can deny you looked absolutely fabulous last night," he said, before signing off.

articles.title: Marital rape: Millions of wives in South Asia unprotected - study
articles.summary: More than 100 countries have outlawed marital rape, but a large part of South Asia has not.
articles.body_text: Failure to fully criminalise marital rape leaves millions of women and girls unprotected in eight South Asian countries, where intimate partner violence is 35% higher than the global average, says a new study. More than 100 countries have outlawed marital rape, but a large part of South Asia - India, Afghanistan, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh - remain among the three dozen countries which haven't. The only South Asian country where rape within marriage attracts the same penalty as any other rape is The Maldives. Nepal and Bhutan have criminalised marital rape, but apply lesser penalties, says the study by Samaj, a coalition of women's rights groups in the region. South Asia's marital rape laws largely stem from British colonial rule, says Ranjeeta Silwal of Equality Now, a global women's rights group part of Samaj. The law, dating to 1860 in India and Bangladesh and 1885 in Sri Lanka, lists exceptions to rape - including sex by a man with his adult wife. Campaigners say the law is outdated and forced sex is rape, regardless of the perpetrator. Experts warn marital sexual violence harms women's physical, psychological, emotional and sexual well-being. More than 100 countries have criminalised marital rape, including the UK, which changed its law in 1991. But the exemption remains in India, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. Pakistan removed the marital rape exception in 2006, but no higher court has confirmed that rape laws apply within marriage. A recent high court ruling, meanwhile, granted husbands broad immunity for non-consensual sex. Since returning to power in 2021, the Taliban have steadily dismantled women's protections in Afghanistan. A new penal code introduced in January made matters worse, Silwal says. Under it, a husband can be prosecuted for violence against his wife only if he causes a broken bone, open wound or severe bruising. Even then, he faces just 15 days in prison if convicted. Unsurprisingly, the code makes no mention of marital rape. But its narrow definition of punishable violence effectively denies women protection against it.

articles.title: Italy's former police chief rejected mafia inquiry allegations before death
articles.summary: The contents of an eight-page letter by Gianni De Gennaro have been revealed days after his body was found at his Tuscany home.
articles.body_text: Italian ex-police chief Gianni De Gennaro has denied misleading investigations into high-profile Mafia killings, in a letter written shortly before his death. His body was found at his Tuscan country home on Saturday and Italian authorities believe he took his own life. A post mortem examination was due to take place on Friday. In his eight-page note, De Gennaro, 78, vehemently denied obstructing the inquiry into the murder of anti-mafia judge Paolo Borsellino in Sicily in July 1992. The Cosa Nostra Mafia was found to have ordered Borsellino's killing and that of fellow judge Giovanni Falcone two months earlier. But several fruitless investigations were later launched into potential cover-ups by high-ranking officials. In a recent inquiry De Gennaro, who in the 1990s worked in the anti-mafia directorate and later became Italy's police chief, was accused of misdirecting the initial investigation. The allegations shocked many Italians, as De Gennaro had worked closely with Falcone and was seen as being on the front line of the fight against organised crime. "In a few minutes I will be gone, so you understand well that a 'man condemned to death' cannot lie," he wrote in the letter, published by Italian daily Corriere della Sera. "I have never betrayed my oath of loyalty to the Fatherland." "I hope that, amid the avalanche of falsehoods now overwhelming me, the truth will ultimately prevail," he added. The case, and the media furore that has surrounded it, have re-opened the wound of the Mafia killings of the early 1990s, which remain an emotionally charged issue in Italy. The story has dominated Italian headlines since De Gennaro's death, with several of the country's most senior political figures publicly commenting on the case. On Thursday Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said she had been "deeply shocked" by the case.

He also described Putin as a "grand master of politics". The latest round of peace talks in Abu Dhabi earlier this month made no obvious progress: "The more we know, the more problems", is how Zelensky described it. articles.body_text: Un helicóptero de la Fuerza Aérea del Perú (FAP) sufrió un accidente este 27 de noviembre mientras cumplía una misión de extracción de una patrulla militar en la región de Ayacucho. El hecho se produjo en las inmediaciones de la localidad de Sanabamba, dentro del ámbito del Valle de los Ríos Apurímac, Ene y Mantaro (Vraem). El siniestro fue confirmado mediante el Comunicado Oficial N° 004-2026-CEVRAEM, emitido por el Comando Especial Vraem. Información preliminar sitúa la ubicación del impacto en la zona de Canayre, provincia de Huanta, e indica que la unidad correspondería a un helicóptero modelo Mi-17. Ante la emergencia declarada en el sector, el mando militar dispuso la activación inmediata de los protocolos de búsqueda y rescate (SAR). Las unidades asignadas ejecutan labores operativas orientadas a localizar la aeronave siniestrada y establecer el estado de los ocupantes a bordo. Hasta la emisión del comunicado oficial, las autoridades militares no han precisado el número exacto de efectivos desplazados en la unidad ni las causas que originaron la falla. Del mismo modo, aunque reportes preliminares señalan la existencia de posibles heridos, dicha información aún no ha sido confirmada por los canales oficiales. El accidente se registró cinco días después de la entrada en vigencia de una prórroga al estado de emergencia decretado en la macrorregión. Mediante el Decreto Supremo Nº 152-2026-PCM, publicado el 20 de noviembre, el Poder Ejecutivo extendió la medida por 60 días calendario en 12 distritos y ocho centros poblados de Ayacucho, Huancavelica, Junín y Cusco. La normativa vigente mantiene la responsabilidad del control del orden interno en manos de las Fuerzas Armadas, con el respaldo operativo de la Policía Nacional del Perú. El despliegue de las fuerzas del orden se desarrolla en el marco de operaciones contra remanentes terroristas y el narcotráfico, resguardando además el eje energético del gas de Camisea que se extiende hasta el distrito de Anco.

articles.body_text: Un helicóptero de la Fuerza Aérea del Perú (FAP) sufrió un accidente este 27 de noviembre mientras cumplía una misión de extracción de una patrulla militar en la región de Ayacucho. El hecho se produjo en las inmediaciones de la localidad de Sanabamba, dentro del ámbito del Valle de los Ríos Apurímac, Ene y Mantaro (Vraem). El siniestro fue confirmado mediante el Comunicado Oficial N° 004-2026-CEVRAEM, emitido por el Comando Especial Vraem. Información preliminar sitúa la ubicación del impacto en la zona de Canayre, provincia de Huanta, e indica que la unidad correspondería a un helicóptero modelo Mi-17. Ante la emergencia declarada en el sector, el mando militar dispuso la activación inmediata de los protocolos de búsqueda y rescate (SAR). Las unidades asignadas ejecutan labores operativas orientadas a localizar la aeronave siniestrada y establecer el estado de los ocupantes a bordo. Hasta la emisión del comunicado oficial, las autoridades militares no han precisado el número exacto de efectivos desplazados en la unidad ni las causas que originaron la falla. Del mismo modo, aunque reportes preliminares señalan la existencia de posibles heridos, dicha información aún no ha sido confirmada por los canales oficiales. El accidente se registró cinco días después de la entrada en vigencia de una prórroga al estado de emergencia decretado en la macrorregión. Mediante el Decreto Supremo Nº 152-2026-PCM, publicado el 20 de noviembre, el Poder Ejecutivo extendió la medida por 60 días calendario en 12 distritos y ocho centros poblados de Ayacucho, Huancavelica, Junín y Cusco. La normativa vigente mantiene la responsabilidad del control del orden interno en manos de las Fuerzas Armadas, con el respaldo operativo de la Policía Nacional del Perú. El despliegue de las fuerzas del orden se desarrolla en el marco de operaciones contra remanentes terroristas y el narcotráfico, resguardando además el eje energético del gas de Camisea que se extiende hasta el distrito de Anco.

articles.body_text: La Sociedad Peruana de Hidrocarburos (SPH) saludó la firma de la adenda al contrato de concesión con Cálidda, que permitirá ampliar la distribución de gas natural a siete regiones del centro y sur del Perú. El gremio destacó que este acuerdo representa un avance importante para la descentralización energética, al facilitar que más familias accedan a los beneficios económicos de este recurso. “Saludamos la firma de este acuerdo, que representa un paso importante para cerrar las brechas de acceso al gas natural en el país. Las familias del centro y sur del Perú merecen contar con una energía más económica y menos contaminante, en las mismas condiciones que Lima y Callao”, señaló Felipe Cantuarias, presidente de la SPH. La modificación contractual contempla una inversión privada de cerca de US$600 millones de para extender la distribución de gas natural a 15 ciudades de Cusco, Puno, Ayacucho, Junín, Apurímac, Ucayali y Huancavelica. En una primera etapa, se proyecta beneficiar cerca de 300 mil hogares, lo que representa aproximadamente 1.2 millones de peruanos. Uno de los principales beneficios del acuerdo será el acceso al gas natural en las mismas condiciones tarifarias que Lima y Callao, lo que permitirá generar importantes ahorros en la economía de los hogares. Asimismo, la disponibilidad de una energía más competitiva contribuirá a reducir los costos operativos de las micro y pequeñas empresas y del transporte, fortaleciendo la competitividad y dinamizando las economías regionales. Se estima además que el acuerdo generará más de 9 mil puestos de trabajo, entre directos e indirectos. “Este acuerdo demuestra que es posible avanzar en la masificación del gas natural con inversión privada y generar beneficios concretos para la población. La descentralización energética debe traducirse en menores gastos para las familias, mayor competitividad para las mypes y nuevas oportunidades de desarrollo para las regiones”, agregó Cantuarias. De acuerdo con los plazos previstos, las primeras conexiones se iniciarán entre 18 a 24 meses desde la firma de la adenda. Para la SPH, este avance debe contribuir a que el acceso al gas natural deje de concentrarse en determinadas zonas del país y llegue progresivamente a más peruanos.

articles.body_text: El precio del dólar inició la jornada de este viernes en S/3,462 en el mercado cambiario peruano, por debajo de los S/3,474 del cierre anterior, con un retroceso de 0,35%. La moneda estadounidense pierde terreno frente al sol por el fuerte repunte del precio del cobre y una mejora del apetito por riesgo en los mercados internacionales, aunque la fortaleza global del dólar limita una mayor apreciación de la moneda peruana. “El cobre registra un avance cercano al 4,7%, alcanzando los US$12,515 por tonelada, lo que representa un respaldo importante para el sol peruano, dada la relevancia de las exportaciones mineras en la generación de divisas. Sin embargo, el dólar internacional se mantiene cerca de sus máximos de 22 meses, en un contexto de cautela frente a las próximas decisiones de la Reserva Federal”, explicó Jorge Luis Huayta, trader FX de Kambista. En los mercados internacionales, el Índice del Dólar Estadounidense (DXY) se mantiene alrededor de los 103.80 puntos, mientras los futuros de Wall Street muestran una recuperación tras el feriado de Acción de Gracias. No obstante, la sesión bursátil reducida por el Black Friday podría limitar la liquidez internacional. Por su parte, el oro y la plata también registran avances, mientras el petróleo Brent se mantiene cerca de los US$97 por barril, ante los riesgos geopolíticos que afectan el suministro energético. En el ámbito local, durante su participación en CADE Ejecutivos, el presidente del Banco Central de Reserva (BCR), Julio Velarde, señaló que la inflación se encuentra por encima del rango meta debido principalmente a choques de oferta y advirtió que el Fenómeno El Niño podría generar nuevas presiones sobre los precios. A ello se suma la reciente revisión del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), que redujo su proyección de crecimiento económico para 2026 de 3,4% a 3,1% por el impacto esperado del fenómeno climático. De cara al cierre de la semana, el análisis de Kambista señala que la recuperación del cobre podría favorecer una mayor apreciación del sol. Sin embargo, la fortaleza del dólar internacional, el encarecimiento del petróleo y las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés en Estados Unidos continuarán siendo factores relevantes para el comportamiento del tipo de cambio durante la jornada.

articles.title: Buque con combustible volcado será remolcado “de forma inmediata” a Cartagena, en España
articles.summary: El buque que transporta combustible y sufrió un vertido será remolcado de inmediato hasta Cartagena, mientras se evalúan sus posibles impactos.
articles.body_text: Las autoridades españolas anunciaron este viernes el remolque a puerto de un buque que transportaba 7.000 toneladas de gasóleo y volcó frente a las costas de Ibiza, en una zona de alto valor ecológico del Mediterráneo, ante el temor a un vertido contaminante. “Tras haber comprobado la integridad estructural y flotabilidad del buque, la operación de remolque hacia puerto seguro se iniciará de forma inmediata, aprovechando las condiciones meteorológicas favorables”, indicó el ministerio en un comunicado. El puerto de Cartagena, en la región de Murcia, en el sureste de España, fue elegido por ser “el único que reúne las condiciones de profundidad, resistencia, espacio para la operación y seguridad necesarias”, agregó el comunicado. El Med Emre, un buque de bandera maltesa propiedad de la empresa turca YMN Tankers, volcó en la noche del miércoles al jueves a 30 millas náuticas (56 km) al norte de Ibiza, en el archipiélago español de Baleares, lo que llevó a las autoridades a desplegar un operativo para prevenir un posible vertido contaminante. Uno de los 17 tripulantes, el jefe de máquinas, murió en el accidente, según informó YMN Tankers en un comunicado remitido a la AFP. La decisión de iniciar su traslado se tomó, de acuerdo con la normativa, tras constatarse “la inviabilidad de que los trabajos necesarios puedan realizarse en alta mar o en un fondeadero expuesto a posibles condiciones meteorológicas adversas”, indicó el ministerio en la tarde del viernes. Realizar estos trabajos en un lugar que pudiera verse afectado por los temporales de otoño e invierno “elevaría de forma inasumible el riesgo de hundimiento y de vertido”, resaltó. Las tareas para retirar la carga y el combustible, así como para el posterior reflotamiento del buque, “se prolongarán varias semanas”, agregó la nota. El presidente del gobierno español, Pedro Sánchez, ya había indicado en la mañana que el buque, del que aseguró que no se había producido ningún vertido de combustible, iba a ser próximamente remolcado a puerto. “Los datos nos indican que efectivamente (...) no se está produciendo esa fuga” de combustible al mar, indicó en una entrevista a la radio cadena SER el dirigente socialista. “El buque sigue estable y sujeto” al barco de Salvamento Marítimo Clara Campoamor “mediante un cabo que lo mantiene en la misma posición”, había explicado la mañana del viernes en X el servicio de emergencias de las islas Baleares. Un remolcador zarpó “con los buceadores a bordo para inspeccionar el estado estructural del Med Emre. Una vez finalizada la inspección, la Dirección General de la Marina Mercante decidirá las actuaciones que será necesario llevar a cabo para continuar con el plan de salvamento del buque”, agregó. El accidente se produjo en una zona “de especial valor ecológico, en la que se solapan dos espacios protegidos”, recordó la oenegé de protección de los océanos Oceana, que pidió una rápida actuación de las autoridades para evitar daños. “No se ha reportado contaminación procedente del buque”, afirmó YMN Tankers en el comunicado, en el que afirma estar en “contacto permanente con las autoridades marítimas españolas”. España conserva vivo el recuerdo de la catástrofe del Prestige, el petrolero de bandera bahameña que se hundió en noviembre de 2002 frente a las costas de Galicia, en el noroeste del país. Unas 63.000 toneladas de fuel se derramaron al mar y contaminaron 2.900 kilómetros de litoral, en uno de los peores desastres ambientales de la historia de Europa.

articles.summary: Vladimir Putin presentó un nuevo submarino nuclear ruso, en medio de los esfuerzos de Moscú por fortalecer su poderío militar.
articles.body_text: El presidente ruso, Vladimir Putin, presentó el viernes un nuevo submarino de propulsión nuclear y afirmó que Rusia añadirá cinco más a la flota del país para 2030, según imágenes difundidas por el Kremlin. En los astilleros Sevmash, en la ciudad de Severodvinsk, en el noroeste del país, Putin asistió a una ceremonia de izado de bandera a bordo del submarino Perm, que marca su transferencia formal a la Armada. “Rusia es uno de los pocos países del mundo capaces de construir poderosos submarinos nucleares de este tipo, armas de alcance y relevancia global”, declaró. Los submarinos de propulsión nuclear son una parte clave de la disuasión nuclear de Rusia, ya que su capacidad de operar de forma encubierta bajo el agua les da la posibilidad de atacar en caso de agresión. Putin dijo que la Armada recibiría cinco submarinos más para 2030, incluidos tres de la clase Yasen-M, la misma clase que el Perm. Los submarinos pueden operar en “cualquier parte de los océanos del mundo” y transportan varios tipos de misiles de crucero, añadió.

articles.title: Helicóptero de la Fuerza Aérea sufre un accidente en Ayacucho durante una misión en el Vraem
articles.summary: Un helicóptero de la Fuerza Aérea del Perú (FAP) sufrió un accidente este 27 de noviembre mientras cumplía una misión de extracción de una patrulla militar en la región de Ayacucho. El hecho se produjo en las inmediaciones de la localidad de Sanabamba, dentro del ámbito del Valle de los Ríos Apurímac, Ene y Mantaro (Vraem).
articles.body_text: Un helicóptero de la Fuerza Aérea del Perú (FAP) sufrió un accidente este 27 de noviembre mientras cumplía una misión de extracción de una patrulla militar en la región de Ayacucho. El hecho se produjo en las inmediaciones de la localidad de Sanabamba, dentro del ámbito del Valle de los Ríos Apurímac, Ene y Mantaro (Vraem). El siniestro fue confirmado mediante el Comunicado Oficial N° 004-2026-CEVRAEM, emitido por el Comando Especial Vraem. Información preliminar sitúa la ubicación del impacto en la zona de Canayre, provincia de Huanta, e indica que la unidad correspondería a un helicóptero modelo Mi-17. Ante la emergencia declarada en el sector, el mando militar dispuso la activación inmediata de los protocolos de búsqueda y rescate (SAR). Las unidades asignadas ejecutan labores operativas orientadas a localizar la aeronave siniestrada y establecer el estado de los ocupantes a bordo. Hasta la emisión del comunicado oficial, las autoridades militares no han precisado el número exacto de efectivos desplazados en la unidad ni las causas que originaron la falla. Del mismo modo, aunque reportes preliminares señalan la existencia de posibles heridos, dicha información aún no ha sido confirmada por los canales oficiales. El accidente se registró cinco días después de la entrada en vigencia de una prórroga al estado de emergencia decretado en la macrorregión. Mediante el Decreto Supremo Nº 152-2026-PCM, publicado el 20 de noviembre, el Poder Ejecutivo extendió la medida por 60 días calendario en 12 distritos y ocho centros poblados de Ayacucho, Huancavelica, Junín y Cusco. La normativa vigente mantiene la responsabilidad del control del orden interno en manos de las Fuerzas Armadas, con el respaldo operativo de la Policía Nacional del Perú. El despliegue de las fuerzas del orden se desarrolla en el marco de operaciones contra remanentes terroristas y el narcotráfico, resguardando además el eje energético del gas de Camisea que se extiende hasta el distrito de Anco.

articles.title: Senamhi advierte que lluvias en Piura y el norte serán más frecuentes durante el verano: ¿Qué regiones están en riesgo?
articles.summary: Las precipitaciones podrían ser más continuas por las condiciones de El Niño. Senamhi también advirtió sobre posibles crecidas de los ríos.
articles.body_text: Las lluvias intensas que afectan a las regiones del norte del Perú podrían aumentar su frecuencia e intensidad durante las próximas semanas, especialmente en la temporada de verano. Así lo advirtió Rosario Julca, subdirectora de Vigilancia Meteorológica del Servicio Nacional de Meteorología e Hidrología del Perú (Senamhi), quien explicó que las precipitaciones están relacionadas con las condiciones del fenómeno El Niño y las elevadas temperaturas del mar frente a las costas de Piura y Tumbes. En diálogo con RPP, la especialista indicó que las precipitaciones más importantes comenzaron semanas atrás en Tumbes y luego se extendieron hacia Piura. En esta última región se registraron acumulaciones superiores a los 100 milímetros de lluvia en un solo día. Julca explicó que las lluvias recientes en Piura comenzaron alrededor de las 5:00 p. m. y alcanzaron una intensidad aproximada de 40 milímetros por hora. La especialista señaló que se espera un incremento de las precipitaciones durante el verano debido a las condiciones asociadas al fenómeno El Niño y al calentamiento del mar frente al litoral norte. Según precisó, las temperaturas del océano frente a Piura y Tumbes se encuentran entre 6 y 7 °C por encima de sus valores normales, con registros de hasta 29 °C. “Ahora es que tenemos un día con lluvias importantes; a los días siguientes tenemos dos o tres días donde tenemos lluvias con menor intensidad y otra vez tenemos un pico alto. En el verano, más bien esperamos que estas lluvias sean de manera más frecuente, más continuas”, precisó. Para este fin de semana se prevé que las precipitaciones continúen en el norte del país, aunque su intensidad podría disminuir temporalmente. Sin embargo, el Senamhi advirtió que la acumulación de agua puede seguir ocasionando afectaciones. Ante este escenario, la entidad recomendó mantener los sistemas de drenaje en condiciones adecuadas y adoptar medidas de precaución frente a las lluvias. En Lambayeque, las precipitaciones más importantes se concentran en las zonas cercanas a la frontera con Cajamarca y en los sectores que conducen hacia la sierra, donde se han superado los 100 milímetros de lluvia. En cambio, para las localidades próximas al litoral, como Chiclayo, se esperan precipitaciones de menor intensidad. La subdirectora de Vigilancia Meteorológica informó que el Senamhi trabaja de manera coordinada con el Centro de Operaciones de Emergencia Nacional (COEN) para emitir alertas dirigidas a la población de Tumbes, Piura y parte de Lambayeque. Los avisos se difunden mediante el Sistema de Mensajería de Alerta Temprana de Emergencias (Sismate), con el propósito de advertir sobre las condiciones meteorológicas y facilitar que la ciudadanía tome precauciones. Otro de los aspectos que genera preocupación es el comportamiento de los ríos ante las precipitaciones en las zonas altas de las cuencas. Julca explicó que las lluvias incrementan el nivel y el caudal de los cursos de agua, cuyo volumen se desplaza posteriormente hacia las zonas bajas. Al referirse a los registros del río Tumbes en la estación hidrológica Cabo Inga, mencionó una medición de 1′947,35 metros cúbicos por segundo. Esta unidad representa el volumen de agua que transporta el río en un segundo. La especialista precisó que el caudal y la velocidad del agua pueden disminuir conforme esta avanza hacia las zonas bajas. No obstante, advirtió que el escenario puede cambiar si las precipitaciones intensas se mantienen durante varios días consecutivos. “Cuando tengamos días consecutivos de estas lluvias importantes, el panorama puede cambiar”, señaló. Finalmente, Julca indicó que incluso precipitaciones de entre 5 y 10 milímetros pueden generar impactos en Piura. Por ello, remarcó que la frecuencia de las lluvias es un factor determinante para evaluar sus posibles consecuencias.

articles.title: Ciudadanos de Piura alzan su voz ante las inundaciones por lluvias: “Exigimos solución”
articles.summary: Vecinos afectados reclaman a las autoridades una intervención inmediata frente a la emergencia que ha afectado sus viviendas por las lluvias por el Fenómeno El Niño.
articles.body_text: Los ciudadanos afectados en Piura expresaron su indignación y desesperación ante las inundaciones provocadas por las constantes lluvias en la región a causa del Fenómeno El Niño. Frente a esta situación, los vecinos exigen a las autoridades una intervención urgente para atender la emergencia. “Exigimos solución” es el grito de los vecinos que han visto sus viviendas inundadas debido a las intensas lluvias en la región Piura. Esta indignación también responde a que, según manifiestan, llevan décadas enfrentando la misma problemática sin recibir una solución definitiva. “Estamos reclamando todos los años porque aquí tenemos viviendo más de 40 años y estamos en las mismas condiciones. Hemos hecho saber a las autoridades de turno todos los años para que hagan realmente un trabajo definitivo que no nos tenga en estos problemas. Pero hasta ahora nunca han dado ese trabajo”, expresó uno de los ciudadanos afectados a Canal N. Asimismo, la ciudadana cuestionó el funcionamiento de las bombas instaladas en la zona, señalando presuntas deficiencias en su ubicación. “No han funcionado las bombas porque están mal hechas. La ingeniera nos ha garantizado que esto iba a funcionar y no ha funcionado ni un 1%... Todas las bombas están inundadas”, declaró. La emergencia ha provocado preocupación entre las familias que no solo deben afrontar pérdidas materiales, sino también la exposición a aguas estancadas, posibles focos infecciosos y dificultades para realizar sus actividades diarias. Las lluvias registradas en la región Piura a causa del FEN 2026 vienen generando acumulación de agua en distintos sectores, afectando principalmente a zonas vulnerables y a las familias que residen en áreas propensas a inundaciones. La falta de drenajes ha provocado serios daños. Se espera que las autoridades y organismos atiendan las zonas afectadas y se tomen las medidas necesarias para reducir los riesgos que enfrenta la población de esta región.

Mediante el Decreto Supremo Nº 152-2026-PCM, publicado el 20 de noviembre, el Poder Ejecutivo extendió la medida por 60 días calendario en 12 distritos y ocho centros poblados de Ayacucho, Huancavelica, Junín y Cusco. La normativa vigente mantiene la responsabilidad del control del orden interno en manos de las Fuerzas Armadas, con el respaldo operativo de la Policía Nacional del Perú. El despliegue de las fuerzas del orden se desarrolla en el marco de operaciones contra remanentes terroristas y el narcotráfico, resguardando además el eje energético del gas de Camisea que se extiende hasta el distrito de Anco.

articles.title: The tech products we enthusiastically recommend this holiday season | TechCrunch
articles.summary: We've been reviewing a bunch of new gadgets at TechCrunch this year, and we have some clear favorites to share for your Black Friday shopping and beyond.
articles.body_text: We’ve been reviewing a bunch of new gadgets and hardware at TechCrunch this year: dumb phones , bird feeders , health trackers , slushy machines , AI mattress pads , you name it. Sometimes we think they’re unnecessary and expensive , but other times, we try out devices that we love so much that we go out and buy them ourselves. If these products can impress a group of (sometimes) curmudgeonly tech reporters, then they’re sure to please whoever you’re shopping for this holiday season. We’ve updated this article with new Black Friday pricing for some of our recommendations. Black Friday deals are likely to end by the end of November 30 (Cyber Monday). We’ve reviewed a lot of e-readers this year. What can we say? We’re nerds. We work for a tech website. But after trying devices from the usual suspects as well as some wildcards, we have recommendations. Evidently, 2026 was the year we fell in love with the pocket-sized e-reader. It’s an e-reader so small that it can fit in your wallet, or even magnetize to the back of your phone. Do you dream of a world where instead of scrolling Instagram when you’re waiting in line for coffee, you actually opt to read books? There’s really something special about the Xteink X3 , and it’s only $55 during Xteink’s Black Friday sale . Fair warning, it takes some fiddling with to set up, and it has no integration with Kindle, Libby, or any other apps, so only buy this for someone willing to do a bit of Reddit browsing and tinkering to get it up and running. If you aren’t planning to magnetize the Xteink to your phone, you’ve got to go with the X4 Pro , which is also discounted for Black Friday . It’s slightly bigger, but it has a backlight, which makes it way more versatile. After using both the X3 and the X4 Pro , I find that the backlight really is a game changer, since I do a lot of reading in bed — plus, I like my Pop Socket wallet a bit too much to displace it for the X3, and I’d rather just carry an extra credit card-sized device than risk forgetting my actual credit and ID cards, which I have grown too used to having on my phone. If I’m being honest, reading my colleague Aisha Malik’s review of the Boox Palma Pro 2 is making me want to buy one. I love using the Xteink e-readers, but they don’t connect to any outside apps. As a hardcore Libby power user (a phrase I am saying in earnest sincerity), it’s a bit frustrating that I can’t get my library books on Xteink e-readers. The same goes for apps like Kobo and Kindle, where any e-book you already own cannot be transferred out of the Amazon ecosystem unless the publisher agrees, which most do not. If you’re looking for an e-reader with a screen that’s actually book-sized, my favorite that I’ve used is the Kobo Libra Colour , which is $259. The Amazon Paperwhite line is great, but c’mon, Amazon. Branch out! Hey, we’ve all got to eat. And if you want, you can make that eating process overly techy. Why not? The Ember Mug 3 is the latest iteration in Ember’s line of coffee/tea cups that actually stay warm. Our reviewer Lauren Forristal especially appreciated that you no longer need to use your phone app to change the mug’s temperature, which seems like it would be really annoying! This mug is perfect for gifting to someone, or to put on your own wish list — you might not want to spend $99 (or $94 right now for Black Friday ) on a mug for yourself, but these sorts of luxury, nice-to-haves are what holidays are made for! Ah, Ninja, the premiere company in the business of turning every appliance into a two-in-one air fryer. I jest, but at least Ninja knows it’s on to something. Despite the Ninja Crispi Microwave and Air Fryer ‘s high price point, Lauren says that this new product made “a pretty convincing case for ditching two appliances and making room for one.” You can’t buy more counter space (without moving), but you can buy more versatile appliances. articles.title: Is Alice Huang a spy or not? | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed exec with whom Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair, is a Chinese spy.
articles.body_text: The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, a former executive at the data-center company Megaspeed, is a Chinese spy. She had an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who abruptly resigned on Nov. 12 after acknowledging it and was just as abruptly reinstated on Monday of this week. What’s publicly known is murkier than the headlines suggest. U.S. intelligence has reportedly tracked Alice Huang’s contact with an officer of China’s spy agency, but officials haven’t offered public evidence that she was commissioned to target Nvidia’s chief. In the past week, after President Trump successfully pushed to bring Jensen Huang back, the administration has played down the allegations it once circulated internally. Whether that reflects new intelligence or political pressure is the big question. Undisputed reporting shows the claim emerged from the White House itself . It first appeared in a highly classified memo written in March under the oversight of Secretary of State Marco Rubio and circulated to White House officials ahead of Trump’s trip to China in May. The memo formed the partial basis for the New York Times’ initial reporting on the scandal, published Oct. 29 and its existence was first reported on Nov. 8 . The memo did not definitively say, according to the Wall Street Journal, that Alice Huang was a Chinese spy. CNN, by contrast, has reported that the memo concluded she was a Chinese intelligence asset. What’s better established is that Alice Huang was in touch with Chinese intelligence. The Ministry of State Security (MSS) is Beijing’s civilian spy agency, responsible for both foreign intelligence and domestic counterintelligence. Last weekend, the Times, citing people with knowledge of U.S. intelligence reports, reported that Huang was in contact with an MSS officer from the spring of 2025 until this fall , a period that overlaps her relationship with Jensen Huang. (The Chinese government has called the spy claims a “smear,” and Megaspeed says Huang left the company in August 2025 and that its business is legitimate.) Attorney General Todd Blanche, who was Trump’s personal defense lawyer before taking over the Justice Department, told journalists on Tuesday: “I have no reason to stand up here and say Nvidia is anything but a good corporate citizen.” On the same day, Trump said a pardon was an option for Jensen Huang but that he did not think one would be needed. Senior intelligence officials reportedly told Congress that the government apparently has no actual evidence that the MSS directed Alice Huang to pursue an affair with Jensen Huang. None of those statements necessarily exonerates Alice Huang as an intelligence agent. Instead, they support the alternate theory that the Chinese government didn’t tell her to begin the affair and that Jensen Huang broke no law by having it. From a certain angle, the circumstantial evidence surrounding Alice Huang looks quite suspicious. She was a top executive at a company investigated for illicitly channeling Nvidia chips to China, and her husband, Kang Wei, is said to have even closer ties to the MSS, with some sources saying he worked for the agency. The timing of the government’s reversal is at the heart of the matter. Trump has said he lobbied the board “directly and indirectly” to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, so it wouldn’t be surprising if officials who serve at his pleasure were recasting the case in terms that satisfy his agenda. That wouldn’t necessarily make their assessments wrong. But unless new intelligence has actually resolved the question, and none has been publicly identified as yet, that backdrop is critical to keep in mind. CBS has also reported that Rubio has privately voiced concerns about aspects of Jensen Huang’s return. Earlier this month, CNN reported that the intelligence community was still working to understand Alice Huang’s relationship with Jensen Huang and that the intelligence collected on her to date does not prove she was acting as a spy for Beijing. After a briefing by top intelligence officials earlier this month, Rep. Jim Himes (D-Conn.), the incoming chair of the House Intelligence Committee, said he was unsure whether she was a spy or a “ useful idiot .” And this week, the Wall Street Journal pointed out that under Chinese leader Xi Jinping, top corporate executives routinely maintain ties to the country’s intelligence service without being formally deputized as assets. The crush of conflicting claims, most from anonymous government sources, obviously leaves large questions unanswered as to what actually transpired. Some of those questions that naturally spring to mind: There are answers to all of these questions, of course, but when the public will get them is anybody’s guess. Jensen Huang is due to appear before the Senate Banking Committee next week, and by the look from the statements of some of its members , he’s likely in for a rough ride. Unfortunately, congressional hearings, particularly public ones, rarely unearth secrets that haven’t already been disclosed.

articles.title: X finally gets parental controls after 20 years | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Elon Musk's social network X has finally added parental controls for teenagers, giving parents and guardians a way to manage what their kids see on the platform.
articles.body_text: After 20 years of existence, X, the social network formerly known as Twitter, has finally added parental controls for teenagers, giving parents and guardians a way to manage what their kids see and interact with on the platform. But unlike most platforms’ implementation of such controls, X is putting its own spin on the system by giving teens a say in the matter. The company said accounts belonging to 13-to-17-year-olds will be set to “protected mode” by default, meaning they won’t be able to see sensitive content, and won’t be served targeted ads. However, X is allowing teenagers to retain a measure of control over their accounts, letting them see what restrictions were made to their accounts. Parents and guardians will also not be able to read their teens’ private messages, see search or viewing history, or post as their teen. The controls let parents see how much time their teen spends on X per week, set daily limits, require their approval for new followers, limit feed recommendations and videos to already followed accounts, filter specific words, turn off sensitive media, specify who can send their teen DMs, and see who they are messaging. The controls arrive months after X came under fire for a lack of controls preventing the platform’s AI chatbot from being used to generate sexualized images of children and women . The social network has also long been rife with child sexual abuse material , misinformation , AI bots, and openly lets users post porn . X has generally not been a platform aimed at teenagers, but that doesn’t mean they don’t use the platform. A 2024 study found that nearly a third of Gen Alpha kids have an X account. The platform itself requires users to be at least 13 years old, though that’s not a high bar given the kind of content on the platform. “Parents want practical tools, and teens deserve room to grow. With Parental Controls on X, families can set the guardrails that fit their home, while teens keep ownership of their accounts and can see every change. Striking that balance is vital and what we set out to build.” Michael O’Herlihy, head of safety at X, wrote in a blog post.
